card.name: Slots before a health-related noun
card.fires_on: Small linking words or commas in medical text where a health-related noun or list item comes next, such as 'Hospital for', 'mind,' or 'shock,'. Also fires on 'health' before 'insurance'.

modes.label: Commas in lists
modes.description: A comma inside a list of body parts, conditions or wellness terms, just before the next item.
modes.example: Evaluate and treat for hypothermia, shock<<,>> fractures and/or burns.

modes.label: Linking word before a body or care term
modes.description: A word like 'for' or 'the' that sits in front of the name of a patient group or body part.
modes.example: a neurologist at Toronto's Hospital<< for>> Sick Children.

modes.label: Health as a modifier
modes.description: The word 'health' or 'Well' used as a modifier in front of another noun.
modes.example: many<< health>> insurance companies require a second opinion

card.writes: It pushes toward 'mental' and away from 'medical', 'health' and 'healthcare' terms, so the next word is less likely to be one of those.
card.plain: It marks spots in health text where a list item or topic word comes next, and it makes 'mental' more likely than 'medical'.
